hypothesis: The operational control label shares structure with four official counter increments and the dense counter-reconstructed pitch group. Shared MultiRMSE trees can use those auxiliary tasks without the rare-class fragmentation of a Cartesian joint classifier or the selector-error multiplication of a mixture of experts.

relationship_to_prior_work.multi_brier: Prior MultiRMSE used mutually exclusive reverse_any one-hot heads only and scored below exact C.
relationship_to_prior_work.dense_joint: The prior 12-class Cartesian classifier had positive source direction but failed the 2021 +25 gate.
relationship_to_prior_work.new_structure: One continuous primary success head (loss weight 4 through scale 2) shares every tree with reverse, middle, ball, strike, fastball, breaking, and offspeed auxiliary heads. No Cartesian class and no separate selector is fitted.

data_contract.auxiliary_label_rule: next same-pitcher official as-of counter increment inside completed history only

candidate.primary_head: control_success scaled by 2.0 during MultiRMSE and divided by 2.0 at inference
candidate.features: exact-C common features plus row-local e53 K20 pitchmix and completed-history e58 group physics profiles
candidate.selection: maximize minimum full gain across 2020/2021, then minimum R gain, then smaller gamma

source_gate.on_pass: Freeze gamma and recipe before 2022/2023; open 2024 only after the locked development contract passes.
